lastCompletedStory.title: Strip CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from host workers only

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-242) added HOST_ONLY_ENV_UNSET = ['CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN'] in src/supervisor/worker-argv.ts, made workerEnvPrefix(isolation: WorkerIsolation) require an explicit isolation argument (only strips the token on 'host'), and gave each of the four argv-builder Options interfaces (ImplementerWorkerArgvOptions, ReviewerWorkerArgvOptions, PlannerWorkerArgvOptions, AuditorWorkerArgvOptions) an optional isolation?: WorkerIsolation field defaulting to 'host' (mirrors the existing workerIsolation ?? 'host' convention). All four production call sites (loop.ts's implementer dispatch, review.ts's makeReviewDispatch, plan-runner.ts's resolveAndSpawnPlanner/Auditor) now pass their already-in-scope workerIsolation const through. worker-container.ts is untouched (still injects the token via -e CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN for container workers). Container parity tests assert divergence (host inner string minus the token substring equals the container inner string), not byte-equality. All quality gates (typecheck, bun test, bun run check:all including file-size ratchet + lint) are green. No follow-up work identified; this closes the root-cause fix described in CAM-242's notes.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed `env -u NAME` (repeatable) surgically removes only the named variable(s) from the child process environment while leaving the rest intact, matching workerEnvPrefix's existing `-u VAR1 -u VAR2 ...` construction; no library-API mismatch found.
